connector.name: Dbatools MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for dbatools - exposes SQL Server management commands as MCP tools
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package dbatools-mcp-server. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the dataplat account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: DBATOOLS_SAFE_MODE
env.description: Set to 'false' to allow write/destructive dbatools operations. Defaults to true (read-only safe mode).

env.name: MAX_OUTPUT_ROWS
env.description: Maximum number of rows returned per command. Defaults to 100. Allowed range: 1–10000.

env.name: COMMAND_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
env.description: Timeout in seconds for each dbatools command. Defaults to 60. Allowed range: 5–3600.

env.name: PWSH_EXE
env.description: Path to the PowerShell executable. Defaults to 'pwsh'.
